internalBreakdown.component: Lab test: word processing, spreadsheets, presentations

chapters.name: Basics of Information Technology
topics: Characteristics and components of a computer: CPU, memory, storage, I/O devices
Primary (RAM, ROM) and secondary memory; storage devices
System and application software, including mobile apps
Networks: PAN, LAN, MAN, WAN; wired and wireless, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cloud
outcomes: Identify components and functions of computer systems

chapters.name: Cyber Safety
topics: Safe browsing and social networks: identity protection, passwords, privacy, confidentiality

chapters.name: Office Tools
topics: Word processor: formatting, headers and footers, tables, pictures, track changes, drawing tools
Presentation tool: layouts, views, formatting, animations, sound, rehearsed timings
Spreadsheets: data entry, auto fill, formulas, SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, MIN, IF, charts
outcomes: Create and edit documents, spreadsheets and presentations

chapters.name: Lab Exercises (Class IX)
topics: Browser settings for secure connection; file system navigation
Letters, reports, greeting cards; a document in an Indian language
Presentations with images, animation and sound
